QuestInfo.name: Checking on Magatia
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: You must prepare for the Black Mage's imminent return. Go see Han the Broker in Magatia.
QuestInfo.2: Han the Broker tells you that some strange stuff went down but everything's fine now.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 90,000
Can proceed to Checking on the Temple of Time

0.0: Thank you for checking on Ellinia. Will you check on the citizens of #bMagatia#k next?

yes.0: Magatia is an important position. Check with #bHan the Broker#k to ensure nothing out of the ordinary is going on.

1.0: Why does Athena Pierce keep thinking I'm on HER side? The way of profit is to remain neutral!
1.1: Tell her, Magatia is how it's always been. The Zenumists and Alcadno are still at each others' throats.
1.2: But not too long ago, some strange folks stopped by in search of an alchemy artifact. That issue was resolved, and things have been quiet ever since, much to my coin purse's dismay.

yes.0: I will contact the Alliance if anything out of the ordinary occurs. Tell Athena Pierce to deposit payment for such services in the usual location.

npc.0: Magatia is an important position. Check with #bHan the Broker#k to ensure nothing out of the ordinary is going on.
